Defined in: [app-hotkeys.ts:440](https://github.com/TanStack/hotkeys/blob/main/packages/hotkeys/src/app-hotkeys.ts#L440)

Holds declared app hotkeys and the user's custom hotkeys. Framework
providers create one and expose it through hooks; devtools read it from
`HotkeyManager.appHotkeys`.

## Example

```ts
const store = new AppHotkeysStore(appHotkeys, {
  customHotkeys: JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('hotkeys') ?? '{}'),
  onCustomHotkeysChange: (custom) =>
    localStorage.setItem('hotkeys', JSON.stringify(custom)),
})
store.setCustomHotkey('doc.save', 'Mod+Shift+S')
```

## Methods

### findConflicts()

```ts
findConflicts(
   id, 
   hotkey, 
   recordedWith?
): AppHotkey<string, 
  | HotkeyChord
  | HotkeySequence
  | null>[];
```

Defined in: [app-hotkeys.ts:560](https://github.com/TanStack/hotkeys/blob/main/packages/hotkeys/src/app-hotkeys.ts#L560)

Other app hotkeys that would collide if `id` used `hotkey`. App hotkeys
collide when their scopes match or either is `'global'`, and their
hotkeys are equal or one sequence starts with the other.

Pass the recorder's `context` for a recorded hotkey. Two hotkeys written
differently can fire for one key press, such as a recorded `Shift+[Slash]`
and a declared `?` on a US keyboard. Only the key press shows that.

#### Parameters

##### id

keyof `T` & `string`

##### hotkey

[`Hotkey`](../type-aliases/Hotkey.md)

##### recordedWith?

[`RecordedKeyPresses`](../interfaces/RecordedKeyPresses.md)

#### Returns

[`AppHotkey`](../interfaces/AppHotkey.md)\<`string`, 
  \| [`HotkeyChord`](../type-aliases/HotkeyChord.md)
  \| [`HotkeySequence`](../type-aliases/HotkeySequence.md)
  \| `null`\>[]

#### Example

```ts
const recorder = new HotkeyRecorder({
  validate: (hotkey, context) =>
    store.findConflicts('doc.save', hotkey, context).length === 0 ||
    'Already in use',
  onRecord: (hotkey, context) =>
    store.setCustomHotkey('doc.save', hotkey, context),
})
```

Defined in: [app-hotkeys.ts:586](https://github.com/TanStack/hotkeys/blob/main/packages/hotkeys/src/app-hotkeys.ts#L586)

Sets the user's hotkey for an app hotkey. `null` unbinds it. A hotkey
equal to the default removes the customization. Pass the recorder's
`context` for a recorded hotkey, as for `findConflicts`.

### setOptions()

```ts
setOptions(options): void;
```

Defined in: [app-hotkeys.ts:485](https://github.com/TanStack/hotkeys/blob/main/packages/hotkeys/src/app-hotkeys.ts#L485)

Updates options. Providers call it with their props on every update.

When `customHotkeys` differs from the value last passed in, it replaces
the current custom hotkeys. An equal value, such as the same saved data
parsed again, keeps changes the user made since. `undefined` changes
nothing, such as while saved data loads; `null` clears them, such as on
sign-out. Replacing does not call `onCustomHotkeysChange`, because the
data came from the app.

#### Parameters

##### options

[`AppHotkeysStoreOptions`](../interfaces/AppHotkeysStoreOptions.md)\<`T`\>

#### Returns

`void`
